title_block.title: Bench Screen Suitability: Administrative Review
title_block.subtitle: Vehicle ladder and Excipient compatibility screen

blocks.p: This review records completion of balance checks, dilution-record traceability and recipe-card reconciliation for local Vehicle ladder and Excipient compatibility screen bench work. It is an administrative review and does not reassess formulation conclusions. The reviewed bench sheets and recipe cards remain the source records.
A failed screen suitability check must be resolved and documented before affected work is treated as suitable. An explanation alone does not turn a failed check into a pass.
The review was carried out under the transition rules. The local master still applies for this year, and project and accession numbers are cited as they were issued.

Balance-check review is complete. Source records retain instrument identity, check date, reference mass, observed value, applicable tolerance and operator initials. Bench-sheet references link weighing work to those entries.
An absent value or unresolved calibration reference cannot support suitability. Any correction retains the original entry and reason for change.
Dilution-record traceability review is complete. Local bench records retain parent-stock identity, transfer quantities, dilution basis and final concentration so the preparation can be reconstructed.
Mass concentration in mg/mL and loading in weight percent describe different quantities. Where both are used, record the mass or volume basis and any conversion assumptions explicitly.
Recipe-card reconciliation is complete for the reviewed work. Card identities, revisions and reviewer sign-offs remain in the source reconciliation records.

rows: Balance records and linked bench sheets
table.caption: Administrative review completion

blocks.p: A change to units or preparation instructions is controlled as a card revision. The original bench record remains traceable to the revision used at the time.

Review completion is recorded here; correction histories, where applicable, remain with the affected source records. This note does not create a separate list of cards or outstanding calibration actions.

The administrative review is complete for balance checks, dilution traceability and recipe-card reconciliation. This conclusion concerns record completion; it does not validate a formulation, authorise dosing or establish a locked scale process.
